It also provides power transmission and distribution; offshore wind power; communication; plants; mobility; residential and commercial buildings; vessels and ports; and information and communications technologies solutions. In addition, the company involves in construction and real estate investment business. The company was formerly known as Taihan Electric Wire Co., Ltd. Taihan Cable & Solution Co., Ltd. was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Anyang-Si, South Korea.
